name: Metropolis Composition
consequences: Composing a metropolis that blends Los Angeles, Detroit, and Miami elements yields a unique urban tapestry, but may alienate fans of traditional GTA settings.
options: Integrate iconic landmarks from all three cities
Create a new, hybrid cityscape with unique architectural styles
Focus on recreating the gritty, post-industrial aesthetic of Detroit
review: This lever introduces trade-offs between fan loyalty and creative innovation. The gap left unaddressed is the potential for an overly generic or uninspired urban environment.

name: Criminal Economy Depth
consequences: Delving deeper into realistic criminal economies enriches gameplay, but may also attract unwanted attention from regulatory bodies.
options: Develop intricate smuggling and trafficking networks
Implement a complex system of organized crime factions vying for power
Create a more nuanced portrayal of petty crimes and street-level hustles
review: This lever introduces trade-offs between gameplay depth and regulatory risk. The gap left unaddressed is the potential for an overly sanitized or unrealistic portrayal of crime.

name: Procedural Generation
consequences: Pushing procedural generation to its limits enables unprecedented gameplay variety, but may compromise on visual fidelity.
options: Prioritize procedural generation for environments and NPC behaviors
Focus on generating unique heist scenarios and mission narratives
Use procedural generation to create varied vehicle configurations and customization options
review: This lever introduces trade-offs between gameplay variety and graphical fidelity. The gap left unaddressed is the potential for a visually underwhelming experience.

name: Morality System Nuance
consequences: Developing a nuanced morality system allows players to make meaningful choices, but may also create player discomfort or controversy.
options: Implement a complex system of karma and reputation
Create a branching narrative with multiple endings based on player choice
Use morality systems to inform NPC interactions and relationships
review: This lever introduces trade-offs between player agency and potential controversy. The gap left unaddressed is the potential for an overly simplistic or uninspired morality system.

options: Partner with gaming hardware manufacturers for exclusive content
Collaborate with music streaming services to create in-game playlists
Work with social media platforms to integrate in-game influencers
review: This lever introduces trade-offs between funding and creative control. The gap left unaddressed is the potential for a loss of artistic vision due to external pressures.

name: Gameplay Innovation
consequences: Focusing on innovative gameplay mechanics yields a unique experience, but may also alienate fans of traditional GTA gameplay.
options: Implement a dynamic weather system with real-time effects

options: Prioritize a traditional, 3-year development cycle

consequences: Implementing a comprehensive urban renewal strategy transforms the city's architecture, revitalizing neglected districts and redefining its character.
options: Redevelop existing infrastructure to create self-sustaining hubs
Incorporate green spaces and public art to enhance community engagement

review: Urban renewal prioritizes physical appearance over social cohesion, leaving unaddressed the potential for displacement of long-time residents.
